T2 built the full executable data plane (2 registry entries, generated index, deterministic generator, drift checker, read-only resolver, 53 focused tests) against the frozen T1 contract; Codex worker-executed, Claude reviewed and found 9 worker-return packet-shape gaps beyond Codex's single reported finding, repaired all of them plus the work order's missing Required Artifact Manifest table, and closed the tranche. Every applicable future CVF foundation must account for INTERNAL_AGENT and EXTERNAL_AGENT_CLI_MCP consumers with IMPLEMENTED, CONTRACT_ONLY, DEFERRED_WITH_REASON, or N/A_WITH_REASON. ASSF-T3 Learning And ADIF Promotion Bridge contract is CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED at material commit 3a481db5 (dispatch e69a836e): Codex worker authored docs/reference/agent_system_skills/CVF_ASSF_PROMOTION_BRIDGE_CONTRACT.md mapping LSC learning signals and ADIF findings into ASSF CANDIDATE entries (reusing the LSC-T4 rootCauseGroupId dedupe and threshold rules, with reviewer-decision/UAT gates and a 5-clause no-self-activation invariant); Claude reviewer independently confirmed all 23 ASSF-T1 target fields and all cited LSC-T4/ADIF enums exist in source, repaired the handoff HEAD block and the worker-return corpus block, and closed. ASSF-T4 External And Legacy Intake Normalization contract is CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED at closure material commit 40b904bc with post-review hardening at material commit 1c89d540 (dispatch 5a4f9591): Codex worker authored docs/reference/agent_system_skills/CVF_ASSF_INTAKE_NORMALIZATION_CONTRACT.md mapping external screening dispositions (ACCEPT_AS_PATTERN, MERGE_AS_PATTERN, 3x DEFER) and legacy ledger dispositions (4x ABSORB, REFERENCE_ONLY, BLOCKED_UNVERIFIED_SOURCE, DUPLICATE) into ASSF CANDIDATE entries with a 5-step reverification gate that rejects provider-local or unreverifiable claims and the ASSF-T3 no-self-activation invariant (clauses 1-2 adapted for the normalizer actor, 3-5 verbatim); Claude reviewer independently re-derived every disposition label against the screening matrix and T0.1 ledger (zero invented labels), corrected two worker-return accuracy defects (an over-stated 'verbatim' invariant claim and a 'no new field' claim that masked two contract-introduced fields security_notes and sourceRevision absent from ASSF-T1), added a T1-alignment note to the contract, closed the tranche, then escalated the repeated source-equivalence worker-return defect pattern to MACHINE_CHECK_CANDIDATE after operator challenge at 1c89d540. Any future ASSF normalizer must cite the normalization contract and first resolve security_notes/sourceRevision against ASSF-T1; a future governed lane should evaluate a worker-return/completion-review linter requiring literal grep/diff evidence beside equivalence claims. ASSF-T5 Composition, Dependency, Conflict, And Capability Controls remains parked pending operator selection and fresh source-verified dispatch; any future promoter must cite the bridge contract and any future normalizer the normalization contract; no normalizer code, promoter code, package instance, SKILL.md, real candidate entry, CLI/MCP adapter, runtime/provider/live/public behavior, automatic activation, or readiness claim is released by T4.
